title: Add Closed Hover Micro Animations to Every Icon
description: Add a hover-triggered micro animation to every icon in the UI. Trigger on hovering the icon itself or its enclosing interactive control (button, link, menu item, tab, etc.). Play once per hover-enter. Every animation must be closed: first keyframe equals last keyframe (rest -> motion -> identical rest), so it ends seamlessly and is loopable. Give every one of the 144 vendored Lucide icons (plus 10 more to be vendored: app-window, square-dashed, redo-2, undo-2, edit-3, align-left, list-ordered, text-cursor, clipboard, file) a bespoke, semantically fitting closed keyframe animation, keyed off the existing data-icon attribute on the central Icon component (ui/js/react/index.tsx). Also add data-icon-kind to non-catalog icon kinds (emoji, text, typst, url/data image, raw svg, node, missing-placeholder) with their own closed animations so literally every icon animates. Remap the non-Lucide "glb" icon id to the vendored "box" icon via an alias. Extend ui.css with the keyframes, a single generic hover-trigger rule, and a prefers-reduced-motion guard. Extend the in-source vitest tests in ui/js/react/index.tsx to assert completeness (every icon id has a keyframes block + assignment) and closed-ness (0% frame equals 100% frame, except declared full-turn spin exceptions ending at +/-360deg). Extend the Icons storybook story with a hover-animation demo grid.
summary:
Added a bespoke, closed (first keyframe == last keyframe) hover micro-animation to every icon in the UI, keyed purely off CSS attribute selectors so no per-icon TS mapping is needed.

Architecture: `ui/styling/js/ui.css` gained a new `🫨IconAnim` region with (1) one generic trigger rule pair — hovering an icon (`[data-icon]`/`[data-icon-kind]`) or its enclosing interactive control (button/a/summary/menuitem*/tab/option/treeitem/combobox) plays `var(--icon-animation)` once, ~500ms ease-in-out by default; (2) 154 bespoke `@keyframes icon-<id>` blocks, one per vendored catalog icon, each choreographed to its meaning (bell rings pivoting at top, trash-2 lid-shakes, folder tips open, chevrons/arrows nudge with overshoot in their direction, loader-2/settings/rotate-*/flip-*/globe/arrow-right-left do a declared full-turn spin ending at ±360deg — the only closed-loop exception — everything else shares an identical `0%, 100%` rest frame); (3) 8 more `icon-kind-*` keyframes for non-catalog icon kinds (emoji/text/typst/image/svg/node/shortcode/missing); (4) a `prefers-reduced-motion` guard disabling all of it.

`ui/js/react/index.tsx`'s central `Icon` component (region `🖼️IconCodec`) now stamps `data-icon-kind` on every branch (node/image/emoji/text/typst/svg/catalog/missing/shortcode), so literally every icon kind animates, not just vendored catalog ones.

Vendored 10 previously-missing but referenced icon ids (app-window, square-dashed, redo-2, undo-2, edit-3, align-left, list-ordered, text-cursor, clipboard, file) as real SVGs under `ui/asset/icon/` — they previously silently fell back to a `circle-dot`/placeholder glyph. Note: mid-task another concurrent session refactored `ui/asset/script.ts` from a lucide-static-fetching vendoring pipeline to reading committed SVGs directly from `icon/`; my 10 new SVG files and the regenerated `icons.ts`/`Icons.cs`/`icons.py` survived that refactor intact (verified: all 154 ids present after regenerating with the new script).

Extended the in-source vitest suite in `ui/js/react/index.tsx` (`if (import.meta.vitest)` block) with a new "icon hover animations" describe (completeness: every `ICON_NAMES`/kind has a keyframes block + `--icon-animation` assignment, parsed directly from the real `ui.css` file; closedness: every keyframes block's 0%/100% frames match except the declared full-turn allowlist) and "Icon hover animation attributes" describe (renders `<Icon>` for each kind, asserts `data-icon`/`data-icon-kind`). All 7 new/existing icon tests pass in isolation; the pre-existing 224-test `framework-renderer-react` suite (which consumes this same `Icon` component) passes in full with zero regressions.

Extended `.storybook/stories/ui/Icons.stories.tsx` with an `IconAnimations` story: a hoverable button-grid over every `ICON_NAMES` id plus one tile per non-catalog kind, to exercise both the icon's own hover and its parent-button hover trigger.

Caveat: could not get a live visual confirmation in this session — this session's Browser pane failed to load the Storybook dev server's streamed JS bundles (`ERR_INCOMPLETE_CHUNKED_ENCODING`) even against a confirmed-stable, directly-launched server process, and a static Storybook build repeatedly stalled/failed (once on an unrelated pre-existing broken story in `compose/algorithm`, once by running 4.5+ minutes with no progress) — both look like environment/tooling friction in this heavily concurrent monorepo rather than anything caused by these changes. The animation logic itself is verified correct at the unit level: every keyframe parsed from the real committed CSS file is closed, every icon id and kind has an assignment, and the React component emits the right attributes for every icon kind.
